overall_goal: Extract an egg yolk and incorporate it into the main mixture.

goals.description: Fetch an egg and position a small bowl.
goals.rationale: The person prepares the workspace by moving a small bowl into place and retrieving an egg from the cupboard.

goals.description: Separate the egg yolk from the white and add it to the main bowl.
goals.rationale: The person cracks the egg, carefully separates the yolk from the white by passing it between the shell halves, and pours the yolk into the large bowl of ingredients.
